welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Muganga wawe azasuzuma ibintu byose mbere y'uko uhura n'uwo mwashakanye.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Ibyo bihuza uruzinduko rwawe n'inyandiko yawe.

labelComplaint.translation: Ni iki cyatumye uza hano uyu munsi?

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Murakoze, reka mbabaze ibibazo bigufi ku birebana n'icyo mwagezeho.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Andika igisubizo cyangwa ukande ku gitekerezo kiri hejuru

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Kanda ku kintu icyo ari cyo cyose kugira ngo ukikosore mbere yo kugitumiza.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Niba ibimenyetso byawe byifashe nabi cyangwa ukaba urimo woroherwa muri iki gihe, ntugategereze uhamagare inzego z'ubutabazi.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Mu gihe cy'amasaha 1~2, jya gushaka ubufasha

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Ibimenyetso byawe bigaragaza ko hari ikintu cyagombye kugaragara vuba.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Urwego rw'ubuvuzi ruzahita rumenya amateka yawe.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Niba ibintu birushijeho kuzamba, jya wihutira kugira icyo ukora

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Kurushaho gukomera mu buryo bukomeye cyangwa mu buryo butunguranye guhita uhamagara inzego z'ubutabazi.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Icyo ni igitekerezo cy'uko ibintu byihutirwa mu buryo bwikora, si icyemezo.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Waba warigeze kubonwa muri iki bitaro mbere y'aho?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Bafite amabaruwa yawe, ku buryo itsinda ryawe ryita ku buzima bwa buri munsi rishobora guhita ribona amateka yawe yose.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: Ese wifuza ko abantu bakubona he?

findScanning.translation: Gusuzuma ibitaro bya Triavi biri hafi yawe...

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Urwo rwandiko rwawe ruri mu itsinda ry'abaganga, tuzakumenyesha igihe umuganga azarufungura.

btnSaveVisit.translation: Jya ushyiraho imihati kugira ngo ugire icyo ugeraho

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Niba ibintu birushijeho kuzamba, jya ukora ibintu byihutirwa

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Niba ibimenyetso byawe bikomeye cyangwa byiyongera mu buryo butunguranye uhamagare ubufasha bw'ubutabazi cyangwa ujye ku biro by'ubutabazi biri hafi yawe.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Twagaragaje ko ikibazo cyawe ari icy'ingenzi cyane ku buryo abagize itsinda ry'abakurambere babizi.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Subiza ibibazo bike ku birebana n'uko umeze kuva aho wasuye.

checkinTrendSame.translation: Ibyo ni na ko byari bimeze.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Ni gute imimerere urimo igereranywa n'iya mbere?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Ibisubizo byawe byoherejwe ku kigo cyita ku barwayi, abaganga bazabigarukaho, kandi niba ari ngombwa bazabiganiraho.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Ibyo bimenyetso bigaragaza ko ukeneye kwitabwaho byihuse.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Iyi gahunda yo gukurikirana ntabwo ikiriho.

claimTitle.translation: Jya ushyiraho imihati kugira ngo ugire icyo ugeraho

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Shyiraho konti ku buntu kugira ngo ushobore gukurikirana uru ruzinduko kandi ujye ushyiraho kode mu gihe kizaza.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Tuzaboherereza kode y'umunsi umwe nta jambo ry'ibanga ryo kwibuka.

authSecuredBy.translation: Umutekano wa Triavi · wubahiriza amategeko ya HIPAA

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Andika telefoni yawe cyangwa e-mail yawe maze tuzatume kode yo kwinjira.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Konti yawe ifitanye isano n'inyandiko z'ibitaro byawe

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Andika nomero ya terefone yemewe (714 nimero)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Ku bw'umutekano wawe no kurinda amakuru y'abarwayi, warasohotse nyuma y'igihe runaka udakora.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Jya ukora check-in kugira ngo utangire gusura abandi.

dashNoPastVisits.translation: Kugeza ubu nta bantu baherukaga gusura.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Muri iyi porogaramu hashyirwaho amajwi yo guhamagara abarwayi · nimero yawe ya telefoni ntizigera ishyirwa ahagaragara.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Jya wifashisha ikoranabuhanga mu guhangana n'ikibazo cy'uburwayi

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Hitamo uwo uhamagara n'uko wumva umeze.

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Kuvuga ibintu mu buryo butaziguye, mu buryo butaziguye, nta mvugo mbi

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Mwaramutse Jordan, ni igihe cyo gufata dosiye yawe yo ku mugoroba...

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Kwirinda mu gihe buri cyiciro cy'umugera giteganyijwe

postVisitCallsDesc.translation: "Uri kumva umeze ute?" nyuma yo kurekurwa

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Nta guhamagara saa cyenda n'igice z'umugoroba saa cyenda n'igice z'umugoroba

yourCareAgent.translation: Umukozi wawe ushinzwe kwita ku bantu

signedOutTitle.translation: Wasezeranyijwe ko utazongera gukora imirimo y'ubucuruzi.

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Urubuga rwawe rw'itumanaho ruzakomeza gukora ongera wiyandikishe kugira ngo ushobore kuyobora amajwi n'ibyibutsa.

callRingVerified.translation: Byemejwe · binyuze ku muyoboro wawe witabwaho {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Ikiganiro cy'ijwi cyashyizwe muri koderi · WebRTC · nimero yawe ntizigera ishyirwa mu bikorwa

callSummaryReported.translation: BYAGENZEWE ku itsinda ryanyu ryita ku buzima

callDevTrigger.translation: Icyuma cyo guhamagara (dev) cyo kwita ku gikangurambaga

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Kugeza ubu nta muntu n'umwe ukeneye kwitabwaho kuri uru ruzinduko.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Niba ibimenyetso byawe byongeye kugaruka cyangwa bikagenda birushaho kuzamba, ujye uhita uhabwa ubufasha bwihutirwa.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Ushobora kuba warakuyeho uru rupapuro cyangwa ukaba utakiriho.

visitDetailBackToVisits.translation: Dusubire ku byo twasuye mu gihe cyahise

visitDetailSafetyNet.translation: AMAKURU yo mu rwego rw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye Yita ku Burenganzira bw'Ikiremwamuntu (SAFETY-NET ADVICE)

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Ujye ugezaho amakuru y'ubuvuzi, kugira ngo umuganga agufashe kumenya amakuru y'ubuvuzi.

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Izina ry'umuntu uganira na we mu bihe by'impanuka

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Guhindura imvugo ya buri karubanda icyarimwe.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ntashoboye gukoporora - hitamo no gukoporora imikorere

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Mbere y'uko ikintu cyose gisohoka mu bitaro, amazina yawe, amakuru y'abantu bavugana nawe n'ibisubizo by'ibisobanuro by'inyongera bivanwaho. Abashinzwe kwita ku buzima bwawe ni bo bonyine babona amakuru agaragaza uwo muntu, naho abahanga mu by'ubushakashatsi n'ubushakashatsi ni bo bonyine babona amakuru atagaragaza uwo muntu.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Jya wemera ko amakuru adasobanutse agufasha kwita ku bantu bose, kandi ushobora kuyahindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Ushobora kubihindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Gukuraho burundu konti yawe n'amakuru y'imishyikirano ufitanye n'abandi.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Jya usaba kopi y'inkuru y'ibyabaye, imiti yawe n'amateka y'imibonano mpuzabitsina.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Ibyo bihanagura burundu konti yawe n'amakuru y'imishyikirano ufitanye n'abandi.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Itsinda ry'abakurikirana rizakubwira kuri interineti mu gihe cy'amasaha 72.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Hitamo imiterere maze usabe ko woherezwa mu mahanga. Tuzayitegura maze tuyoherereze umurongo wiringirwa kuri interineti yawe yandikishijwe intoki.

downloadRequestSubmitted.translation: Ibyifuzo byo kohereza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Mu masaha 24, tuzajya tumwoherereza ubutumwa bwo kuri interineti butuma ubona aderesi yawe yandikishijwe intoki.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Nta dosiye ushobora gukuramo hano - inyandiko zawe zoherezwa kuri interineti yawe.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Jya ushyiraho urubuga rwo gutumira urwo rwandiko rwatanzwe n'ibitaro byawe, cyangwa ushakishe kode yabo ya QR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Ibyo ntibigaragaza ko ari ikoranabuhanga rya Triavi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code
inviteScanSubtitle.translation: Jya werekeza kamera yawe kuri code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Amategeko y'ikigo cy'ubuvuzi akwiriye kugushyikiriza amakuru yawe.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Koresha kode y'ikigo cy'ubuvuzi kugira ngo umenye amakuru yawe.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Uha kamera uruhushya mu myugariro yo mu mushakisha yawe, cyangwa ujye winjiza umurongo wo gutumirira ku rukuta.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Nta kamera yabonetse. Ahubwo kanda umurongo wo gutumirira uwo bitaro byohereje.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script

otpGroupAriaLabel.translation: Kodi y'umunsi umwe, igizwe n'imibare itandatu
